thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT fired for service=redwood-inference | symptom=tail_latency_p99 | region=us-west-2 | value=2.3s :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Incident created: PD-8742 — High tail latency affecting inference requests. Page sent to on-call.

alex: acked via PagerDuty :white_check_mark: i'm on it, grabbing dashboards.

meera: thanks alex — are we seeing elevated traffic or a regression? any deploys around the window?

alex: no deploys in last 30m per deploy-bot. traffic looks slightly up, but not enough to explain 2.3s p99.

dan: logs show a handful of timeouts from the model side around the same time. attaching snippet:
```
2026-03-14T14:00:12Z ERR model-serving timeout id=abc123 latency=2300ms route=/v1/complete
2026-03-14T14:00:14Z WARN kv-cache miss rate=0.67 hotpath=decoder
```

samira: kv-cache miss rate that high could blow up decoder work. can we check node memory / evictions?

alex: checking node metrics now. one GPU node in pool inference-pool-a reports high GPU mem and swap activity.

ops-rotation: FYI we have Autoscaler on for that pool but not aggressive for p99 tail. current minReplicas=3 max=8.

meera: runbook step 2 suggests 'temporarily increase pool and enable conservative fallback model'. i'd propose: scale pool + route small percentage traffic to smaller quantized variant.

alex: agreed. scaling to 6 replicas and opening 10% traffic to model=redwood-small-q4 fallback. running patch:
```
kubectl scale deployment inference-pool-a --replicas=6 -n inference-prod
# or
redctl pool resize inference-pool-a --replicas 6
```

alex: scaled to 6. autoscaler will keep at least that for 5m.

dan: updating routing: added traffic-split for 10% to redwood-small-q4 via routing-service.

meera: can you also toggle kv-cache TTL to be more aggressive for prefix caching? low risk.

alex: bumping prefix cache TTL and increasing cache size limit. config payload:
```
cache.prefix_ttl: 45s -> 120s
cache.max_entries: 200000 -> 400000
```

samira: i synced with infra — one node had a stuck python worker that prevented local eviction. we restarted that worker on node ip-10-0-12-45.

alex: after scaling + routing + cache changes: p99 dropped from 2.3s -> 820ms over last 2m. p95 steady at ~120ms.

meera: good milestone. did we see any customer errors (5xx) or timeouts?

dan: small spike in 504s correlated with the time of the spike (~14:00:10-14:00:20) about 0.03% of requests. most recovered after restart.

alex: posted timeline to incident page: https://wiki.redwood.internal/incidents/PD-8742 (adding root cause notes).

ops-rotation: PagerDuty note: status -> acknowledged, responders: alex, meera, dan, samira. escalation paused.

meera: i'll hold on rolling back any config until we watch for 15m. if stable, we can reduce replicas back to baseline and keep fallback routing at 0% after warmup.

samira: also capturing a metric delta: decoder op count per request rose ~1.8x during the spike — likely kv-cache churn causing repeated decoding. logging that for postmortem.

alex: quick mitigation checklist done: scaled pool, restarted stuck worker, increased cache ttl/size, routed 10% to quantized fallback, restarted watcher.

meera: customer impact note for postmortem: transient tail latency increases causing small number of 504s for production inference endpoints in us-west-2 between 14:00–14:03 UTC. no data exfiltration.

dan: what do we want to do for next steps? my suggestions:
- run an eviction audit to ensure no other stuck processes
- add alert for kv-cache miss rate >0.5 for >1m
- tweak autoscaler to consider p99 not just p95

alex: +1 to all. i'll create follow-ups: PD-8742-1 (eviction audit), PD-8742-2 (alerting), PD-8742-3 (autoscaler policy change).

pagerduty: PD-8742 status: acknowledged -> monitoring.

meera: 15m check: p99 holding at ~780ms, 504s returned to baseline. we can plan to revert routing 10% -> 0% in 10m and scale to 4 replicas.

alex: reverting routing and scaling to 4 now.
```
redctl route update inference-default --split model=redwood-small-q4:0%,model=redwood-v2:100%
kubectl scale deployment inference-pool-a --replicas=4 -n inference-prod
```

samira: rollback done. monitoring.

meera: closing notes: assign postmortem to dan, timeline + mitigation already logged. no customer-facing post yet, suggest a short status email if customers ask.

alex: thanks team. i'm un-acking on PagerDuty to handoff to next on-call in 30m.

ops-rotation: handoff noted. next on-call: @meera (18:30-19:30 UTC) — please take watch.

incident-bot: Incident PD-8742 -> resolved (monitoring) :white_check_mark:

meera: ack, watching for 30m then will close if stable.

samira: leaving runbook suggestions in the ticket about adding a kv-cache eviction watchdog and adding p99-based scaling.

dan: added logs + metric graph links to ticket. will draft postmortem outline.

alex: nice work everyone, quick ops. :thumbsup:

(reacts: meera :eyes:, samira :sparkles:)
